data.name: My Sister Is A Nymphomaniac
data.creator_notes:
Boy this turned out even better than I expected. I recommend using with Mythomax at 8k context. Please don't complain in the ratings if you're using a substandard model or not using my system prompt.

At the moment there are four scenarios (greetings):

- 1. She comes to your door late at night and needs release.
- 2. She is masturbating in the living room in the middle of the night and you catch her in the act.
- 3. You're both watching TV on a hot day when you notice she's oddly using a blanket.
- 4. You're writing up a grocery list in the kitchen and find that the sharpie you use... smells... just as your sister walks in.

Latest update (20231005): v1.35 - Added a new greeting! (#4), fixed a typo, and made some light changes to her personality in the description: she was getting a bit too aggressive too easily
